name: dsh-sync-backup
description: DSH timed backup: packs the memory layer (memory/handoff/skills/storages/sessions) that dsh-config-manager does not cover and uploads it to WebDAV + GitHub. No third-party npm dependencies; the two declared peers are provided by the harness.
comment:peerDependencies: Required by the DSH loader, not a runtime dependency. For a `link:` install the plugin is reached through a symlink, so Node resolves bare specifiers from the plugin's real on-disk location, where no harness packages exist; app-boot only intercepts a linked package when the plugin itself declares that peer (readPeerNames at lib/types/profile-resolution/resolver.js). Omitting these makes the plugin fail to load with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on @deepseek-ai/schemastery. Nothing is installed from them: the profile sets autoInstallPeers=false and the harness supplies both packages.

scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run security-smoke && npm run client-smoke && npm run client-contract && npm run crypto-smoke && npm run webdav-smoke && npm run github-smoke && npm run scheduler-smoke && npm run channels-smoke && npm run dry-run
